description: Saves a named Mastering preset on the account (POST /mastering/presets): a name of 1 to 60 characters, unique among the account presets, and the settings (all eight modules with value and enabled, a loudness target, normalize). Each value must be within its range and on its step: read them with jj_mastering_capabilities, or copy the settings of a built-in preset and change a few values. The API answers 422 with the path of every rejected field when the settings are invalid, 409 when the name is taken or the 50-preset cap is reached. Open to any account, free or Premium. Counts one unit of the daily write quota. Only call it when the user asked to save a preset.

name.description: Preset name, 1 to 60 characters, unique on the account.

modules.description: All eight modules are required: autoEq, lows, mids, highs, deEss, width, loudness, destruct.

enabled.description: False bypasses the module whatever its value.

value.description: Position of the module, within the range and on the step given by jj_mastering_capabilities.

normalize.description: Whether the render is normalised to the target loudness.

target.description: Loudness target: streaming, apple, deezer, podcast or club.

name: jj_create_mastering_preset
title: Create a Mastering preset
